# Uncached DRAM alias rule

Cached DRAM 0x60000000 to 0x7fffffff; the uncached alias of a is (a & 0x3fffffff) | 0x80000000.

**Category:** layout · **Address:** `0xa0000000` to `0xc0000000` (runtime uncached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

The firmware's own helpers convert both ways. Large firmware buffers sit at 0xa2000000 to 0xbfffffff and are used uncached; the installed DRAM size is not established. Buffers handed to file or DMA code are given as uncached addresses.
